params.body:
Removes the "peak hours" tag from the supervisor line on Overview.

gentells-pipeline #409 removes the supervisor's peak-hour brake. On weekdays from 13:00 to 19:00 GMT it allowed at most two workers and multiplied the paid phases by 0.7. The brake existed because the five-hour session limit drained faster at peak, and that limit is gone from the plan the Claude logins are on. The supervisor state therefore no longer carries `isPeak`, so this tag could never show again. Nothing else on the dashboard reads a field that #409 changes; its new fields (`budget.spend` per account, `week` on `/accounts`) only add to what is there.

Merge order does not matter: before #409 the tag shows as it did, and after it there is nothing to show.

Checks: `vite build` passes. `eslint` on Overview.jsx reports the same two errors as main (`Date.now` in render, `document.title` in the component), both on lines this change does not touch.
params.title: Overview: drop the peak-hours tag
